verdict.rationale: Shortwave is an email client, so open-protocol access and standards-based export are fair questions to ask of it. The evidence does not show it delivering either. The founder states it uses Gmail's APIs rather than IMAP, and a user notes it only works with Google servers. No IMAP/JMAP/SMTP access or standard export format (e.g. mbox/EML) is documented. One user felt switching back to Gmail was low-risk, but that comes from the mail staying in Gmail, not from any open-protocol or export capability Shortwave provides.
